newsitem.title: USA: EndoVascular wins FDA approval for trial.
newsitem.headline: EndoVascular wins FDA approval for trial.

text.p: EndoVascular Technologies Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved an investigational device exemption for it's Aortoiliac EGS system.

The FDA granted the company's request to bypass Phase I trials and proceed directly into a Phase II clinical trial of the device which will shorten the regulatory schedule for the treatment by four to six months.
The device is designed to address aneurysms in which one iliac artery is unsuitable for endovascular attachment of an implant.

The Phase II clinical trial, to be conducted at 20 U.S. investigative sites, is a prospective study comparing mortality, complications and length of hospital stay data from patients treated with the Aortoiliac EGS system to patients undergoing traditional aneurysm surgery.
